competitions._source: Lega Pro C.U. n. 36/L of 29/07/2026 (the regulation): 56 clubs in 4 geographic groups of 14 (numbers 5-60 drawn, the lower number at home = a drawn host), the 4 Serie C clubs of the Coppa Italia as seeds in round 2 (one per group by proximity, at home), drawn within each group to the last 16, an open draw from the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final over two legs (points, goal difference = the aggregate; extra time, penalties), single matches straight to penalties. The groups by proximity (Davide 09/11, 42-s2ko Q1): each club's town (it.wikipedia 2026-27 season pages, Wikidata coordinates) to the nearest of the 2026-27 groups' centres with room; on the real 2026-27 clubs 53 of 56 land in their real group (Forli, Picerno, Grosseto do not), the 4 seeds all. Season 1: C.U. 1/CIT (groups, rounds 1-2, the last 16) with the hosts as played -- three field swaps under art. 5 (C.U. 11/CIT: Spezia-Vado, Trento-Desenzano; 20/CIT: Dolomiti Bellunesi-Desenzano) --, the quarter-finals as drawn (C.U. 22/CIT); results: it.wikipedia.

Lega Serie A C.U. n. 253 of 27/05/2024 (regulation 2024-25 .. 2026-27): 3.1 the Ranking a-g and the numbers 1-44, Allegato 1 the bracket, 3.2-3.8 hosts and deciders; the 2026-27 numbers and the field swap Palermo (25) - Lecce (17) in the round of 64: it.wikipedia 'Coppa Italia 2026-2027'. The C group winners / runners-up are ranked by points per match (as applied in 2026-27: groups of 20 and 19 clubs), the C.U. says points; the substitute 'meglio classificata ex art. 49 NOIF' of the national play-off's 2nd round = place, then points per match (Ravenna in 2026-27). 'unknown' (MC Q5 2, declared, not C.U.): a fact the save lacks -> the holder = the champion; promoted / relegated = by place; the play-off final's loser = the best placed non-promoted of B 3rd-8th; the play-out winner = the 16th; the C play-off winner or the Coppa Italia Serie C winner = the 2nd round's best (the C.U.'s own substitute, also 'if the Coppa Italia Serie C is not played'); the 2nd round's clubs = C places 2-10.

Lega Serie A C.U. n. 43 of 01/10/2026: one match, extra time, penalties; the champion v the Coppa Italia winner, its finalist when they are one club (Inter v Lazio, Meazza, 22/12/2026); venue: neutral (Q4, MC); 'unknown' (declared): the cup winner / finalist -> Serie A's 2nd.
